answer: The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ledge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
